              Profile

              About Me

              Javid Ahmadi

              Software Engineer · Founder of Wakhan Technologies

              Full-Stack Developer — React & Django

              I'm Javid Ahmadi, a Kabul-based software engineer and full-stack developer, and the founder of Wakhan Technologies. I have been building real software products and personal projects since January 2023, and in 2026 I built the Wakhan Technologies product line. This portfolio presents its four flagship systems: Hospital PRO, Institute PRO, SuperMarket PRO and Restaurant PRO.

              My focus is practical software: systems that work both online and offline — offline on your own computer or local network, and online on a server when needed — speak Pashto and English, and are simple enough for any team to run from day one — with the security patterns real businesses need, like PIN login, audit logs and reliable backups.

              Databases are part of every build: each system runs on a properly designed database — PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite — with backup and restore built in, and I offer database design as a service of its own.
